job.title: 483. Integrity Staffing - Project & Contract Administration
job.description:
Assist in the delivery of projects by providing project and contract administration support and the delivery of assigned project components.

Project Administration
  • Assist with the development and production of project management documentation used in the definition and delivery of projects, including project plans, monthly reports, project variations and schedule information.
  • Undertake the investigation of straightforward issues and provide information to the Project Managers for further consideration or action.
  • On behalf of the Project Managers, collect data and monitor the progress of assigned projects, prepare progress reports and assist the Project Managers to address issues that may affect performance indicators and/or milestones.
  • Coordinate assigned project components on behalf of the Project Managers to ensure that deadlines are met.
  • Liaise with personnel at all levels within the client organisation as required. External to the client organisation, the position may liaise with stakeholders, government agencies and private enterprise as required.
  • Assist the Project Managers in providing support to groups such as Steering Committees, including the preparation of reports and meeting papers, minute taking and agenda distribution.
  • Follow processes and project management systems, including those for the verification and processing of invoices for accounts payable/receivable relevant to a project.
  • Assist with site visits and recording of site information.

Contract Administration
  • Assist in the administration of contracts for the project teams.
  • Register and maintain contract documentation (excluding drawings).
  • Monitor incoming and outgoing contract correspondence to ensure project procedures are maintained and the Project Manager is aware of key communication.
  • Review project claims against contract conditions.
  • Assist in the administration of contract progress claims, particularly with respect to receipt of claims, monitoring assessment timing, preparing draft certificates and monitoring payment timing.
  • Assist in monitoring the status of contract requirements for insurances and securities.
  • Assist with contract/procurement document preparation and distribution.

Selection criteria
1. Core Competencies
  • Substantial understanding and experience in providing project management and administrative support to a project management team, including an understanding of:
  • Contract administration and applying established templates and standards.
  • The basic principles of project scheduling (Gantt Charts).
  • The basic principles of risk management.
  • The basic principles of scope and change management and key procurement activities.
2. Communication and Interpersonal
  • Highly developed verbal and interpersonal skills, including the ability to work effectively as the key support person within a project team environment.
  • Well-developed word processing skills, with a proven capacity to prepare quality written correspondence.
3. Conceptual, Analytical and Problem Solving
  • Sound skills in identifying trends and issues and making recommendations that contribute towards ongoing improvements.
4. Organisation
  • Well-developed organisational skills, with the ability to work with minimal supervision and manage competing demands within a project environment.
5. Computer Literacy
  • Sound computer literacy, including the ability to use Microsoft Excel and computerised records management systems.
6. Special Requirements
  • Provision of a current National Police Clearance certificate, dated three months or less from the date of application for the position.

job.title: 106. Integrity Industrial - Parks and Gardens Co-Ordinator
job.description:
Integrity Industrial is currently seeking an experienced Parks & Horticulture Coordinator to support the Operations Manager at a Government Facility in Burswood. This is a hands-on, field-based role responsible for overseeing horticultural, turf and landscape maintenance activities across one of Perth's premier parklands.

This position would suit a highly experienced horticultural professional with strong technical knowledge of turf management, irrigation systems, contractor management, and landscape maintenance.

Key Responsibilities
  • Oversee the delivery of horticultural, turf and landscape maintenance services across Burswood Park.
  • Monitor and manage the performance of grounds maintenance contractors to ensure services meet operational and contractual standards.
  • Provide specialist advice on horticulture, turf management, arboriculture, irrigation and landscape maintenance.
  • Coordinate turf and landscape reinstatement works following major events.
  • Monitor the condition of horticultural assets and implement corrective actions as required.
  • Support the planning, delivery and continuous improvement of grounds maintenance programs.
  • Contribute to horticultural planning, reporting and resource management.
  • Promote safe work practices and ensure compliance with relevant WHS legislation and procedures.

Essential Skills & Experience
  • Proven hands-on experience in a field-based horticulture, turf management or parks maintenance role.
  • Experience restoring and managing broadacre turf in golf courses, sports fields or similar environments.
  • Strong technical knowledge of herbicides, fertilisers and plant growth regulators.
  • Experience managing large-scale irrigation systems, ideally Toro Lynx.
  • Sound knowledge of turf and grounds maintenance equipment and operational practices.
  • Strong understanding of workplace health and safety requirements relating to chemicals, plant and contractor management.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal technical supervision.

Requirements
  • Current WA Driver's Licence (mandatory)
  • White Card (preferred)
  • Certificate III in Horticulture (desirable)
  • Turf, arboriculture, horticulture or related qualifications highly regarded
  • National Police Clearance (within 6 months or willing to obtain)

Assignment Details
  • 37.5 hours per week
  • Flexibility required between 6:30am and 5:30pm to meet operational and event requirements
  • 5-month casualassignment
  • Immediate start available

What's on Offer?
  • Opportunity to work within one of Perth's most iconic parklands
  • Diverse role combining horticulture, turf management, irrigation and contractor coordination
  • Autonomy and variety in a technically focused environment
  • Supportive team and dynamic outdoor workplace

If you have a strong background in horticulture, parks maintenance or turf management and are looking for your next challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now with your current resume.
